benefit_text: The scheme gives Shishu loans up to Rs.50,000, Kishore loans above Rs.50,000 up to Rs.5 lakh, Tarun loans above Rs.5 lakh up to Rs.10 lakh, and Tarun Plus loans up to Rs.20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have repaid previous Tarun loans.
who_can_apply: Any individual, proprietary concern, partnership firm, private limited company, public company or other legal form can apply. The applicant should not be a defaulter and must have a satisfactory credit track record. The borrower may need the necessary skills or experience for the proposed activity.
documents: Proof of identity (Voter ID, PAN, Aadhaar, etc.), proof of residence (recent utility bill or similar), recent coloured photograph, proof of identity/address of the business enterprise, and statement of accounts for the last six months if loan is Rs.2 lakh or above.
how_to_apply: Go to the PM Mudra official website and select the Udyamimitra portal. Click “Apply Now”, enter name, email and mobile number and generate OTP. Then fill personal and business details, choose the loan category, attach the required documents and submit the application.
